mapper.select: SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.util.token.TokenMapper.selectTokenAccess */ token_user_id, token_key, user_ip_address, user_agent FROM zzz_token_access WHERE token_user_id = #{tokenUserId} AND expires_at > NOW()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO /* com.seinfo.protoA.util.token.TokenMapper.insertTokenBanned */ zzz_token_denied ( token_usr_id , token_key , token_denied_desc , reg_dt , expires_at ) VALUES ( #{tokenUserId} ,#{tokenFingerprint} ,#{tokenDeniedDesc} ,now() ,TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE,30,NOW()) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE token_key = VALUES(token_key), token_denied_desc = VALUES(token_denied_desc), reg_dt = VALUES(reg_dt), expires_at = VALUES(expires_at)

INSERT INTO /* com.seinfo.protoA.util.token.TokenMapper.insertTokenAccess */ zzz_token_access ( token_user_id , token_key , user_ip_address , user_agent , reg_dt , expires_at ) VALUES ( #{tokenUserId} ,#{tokenFingerprint} ,#{userIpAddress} ,#{userAgent} ,now() ,TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE,30,NOW()) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE token_key = VALUES(token_key), user_ip_address = VALUES(user_ip_address), user_agent = VALUES(user_agent), reg_dt = VALUES(reg_dt), expires_at = VALUES(expires_at)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zzz_token_denied WHERE token_key = #{token} AND expires_at > NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM zzz_token_access WHERE expires_at <= NOW()
